name: Sniper (Ex)
body:
Prerequisite: Saboteur 6

Benefit: When the saboteur uses the Stealth skill to snipe, she only suffers a –10 penalty on the Stealth check, instead of –20. If she successfully snipes an opponent with a ranged attack, she adds her Intelligence modifier to the damage dealt (in addition to all other modifiers).
